description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for verifying interactions between Git and Perforce (p4), including trigger configurations, depot initialization, cloning, importing, and submitting changes. It executes commands related to p4 triggers and other p4 operations, as well as Git commands, to validate correct behavior.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository after tests are run.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to be executed after the test completes.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.
